note: Offline model catalogue. `installed` entries ship inside the binary (or in dist/models) and are verified against their sha256. `available` entries are installable straight from the Models screen: the application builds them on this computer from material it already carries, so installing needs no network and no file picker. `manual` entries are free upstream models whose weights are not in the binary (a licence click-through or a format conversion is needed), so they are listed with no url and a note saying so: the application installs those from a local file instead of pretending a download would work. Nothing here is fetched at runtime.
